# ClassIsland — classroom notification providers and presentation

Source: the ClassIsland project and its contributors, [commit 235914a2fac1733cc2a169457c7bad4edb2ca2f6](https://github.com/ClassIsland/ClassIsland/tree/235914a2fac1733cc2a169457c7bad4edb2ca2f6). Extracted and integrated into ClassNEX on 2026-11-23.

| Original file | Code used in ClassNEX |
| --- | --- |
| `ClassIsland/XamlThemes/FluentTheme/Styles.axaml` | The `ProgressContainer`/`OverlayTimeProgressBar` subtree, independent 300 ms background-width transition, overlay exit transition and mask reveal resources. The binding ancestor is the ClassNEX classroom window. |
| `ClassIsland/Controls/MainWindowLine.axaml`, `MainWindowLine.cs` | The remaining-progress property, ordering of title, detail and schedule, overlay-only progress and interruption. The existing ClassNEX transparent window is the host. |
| `ClassIsland/Controls/NotificationProviders/ClassNotificationProviderControl.axaml(.cs)`, `ClassIsland/Services/NotificationProviders/ClassNotificationProvider.cs`, `AfterSchoolNotificationProvider.cs` | Typed countdown/break runs, next subject, teacher and time; ten-second page selection and event-specific mask/detail durations. ClassNEX measures the caption and lesson separately instead of using the upstream equal columns. Bindings consume the local schedule service. |
| `ClassIsland.Core/Controls/NotificationTemplates/TwoIconsMaskTemplate.axaml`, `SimpleTextOverlayTemplate.axaml` | Two-icon mask and separate single-message dismissal page, including margins, fonts and alignment. |
| `ClassIsland.Core/Themes/SlidingListBox.axaml`, `Layers.axaml` | Unmodified provider-scoped dependencies in `Styles/Upstream/ClassIsland`. `ClassIslandClassroomNotification.axaml` includes the upstream mask scale/opacity keyframes, informative foregrounds and relevant text-baseline offsets. |
| `ClassIsland/Controls/SlantedMaskControl.cs`, `Controls/NotificationEffects/RippleEffect.axaml(.cs)`, `Views/TopmostEffectWindow.axaml.cs`, `platforms/ClassIsland.Platforms.Windows/Services/WindowPlatformService.cs` | The five slanted segments retain their original weights and drawing overlap. The optional screen ripple uses the last valid window center and distinguishes a fullscreen foreground app from the Explorer desktop on the selected monitor. |
| `ClassIsland/Services/NotificationWorkerService.cs`, `LessonsService.cs` | Overlay-only timing: elapsed wall time for explicit end times; accumulated playback plus a stopwatch for fixed durations. Sampling uses the original 50 ms render cadence while an overlay is active. ClassNEX supplies its scheduler/clock and cancellation. |
| `ClassIsland.Core/Converters/DateTimeToTotalSecondsConverter.cs` | The class preparation countdown rounds to the nearest second and displays zero below half a second, independently of when the overlay expires. |
| `ClassIsland.Core/Models/Notification/NotificationPlayingSessionInfo.cs` | Playback session model in `ClassNex.Notification.Service/Upstream`; namespace and visibility scoped to the local service. |

The ClassIsland application sources above are under GNU GPL v3.0. ClassIsland.Core models, templates and styles are under GNU LGPL v3.0. The full license texts are the ClassNEX repository's `LICENSE` (identical to ClassIsland's `LICENSE.txt`) and `third_party/ClassIsland/LGPL-3.0.txt`; in desktop distributions they accompany this notice as `GPL-3.0.txt` and `LGPL-3.0.txt`. ClassIsland does not maintain this integration.

The ClassNEX host adapts preparation progress to the scheduled lesson start, expands and wraps text to fit the active monitor, and handles scrolling and the transition back to the live timetable. These host behaviours and the reduced-motion path are not claims of frame-for-frame parity with ClassIsland. The source comparison covers the standard mask, rail and provider templates under the recorded sample conditions.

`Assets/NotificationFonts` embeds the two unmodified font files from the pinned upstream `ClassIsland.Core/Assets/Fonts`: `lucide.ttf` (blob `6588f1be74ff19d3403fdff57ef08291e1784499`) and `FluentSystemIcons-Resizable.ttf` (blob `18e62f1bbdc7f7ede27ec576efb08c907f9755e7`). Their original family names and glyph maps are unchanged. Classroom providers use Lucide U+E0FF, E224, E250 and E54F, and Fluent System Icons U+ED34 (`ic_fluent_person_running_20_filled`). The dependencies are scoped to notification glyphs: the other windows continue to resolve their own icon font. No ClassIsland logo or branding assets are used. Lucide's ISC and Feather's MIT terms accompany the fonts in `Lucide-Feather-LICENSE.txt`; Microsoft Fluent System Icons uses the MIT license in `FluentSystemIcons-LICENSE.txt`.

The overlay uses the unmodified `ProgressBarStyles.axaml` (blob `0831de01a997ecb6fca5add55ffc41f1a2ba3bfc`) and `ListBoxStyles.axaml` (blob `d85bf5a047d4799b2df2c5c5e4069188655cb720`) from [FluentAvalonia 2.4.1](https://github.com/amwx/FluentAvalonia/tree/a1dc0c0428ff0a2d9e5368dc73ea0358eab459d7). The latter restores the original scroll host and content width underneath the classroom slide animation. Both are scoped to this overlay.
